prompts.text: Provide a summary of recent sessions -- it has been a week since I have worked with you, and would like to start where we left off
Start with the scan and push, then let's review memory settings as I've given the VM more resources

Update run-verification to something much larger as well. Find a balance between the streams and verification jobs, as those run formal proofs that will be resource hungry too, then give me a summary…
Commit and push / publish all changes, then I will execute the command to start next loop.
Summarize where the current loop is at
Summarize where the current loop is at
For decision 1, choose option A - allow the additional download locations
Let's plan to address the sync conflicts so they don't interupt future streams - there should be no reason for a conflict there to interupt work
Look into how we can elegantly address the check error for missing manifest as well -- this doesn't seem to be as big of a deal, but it is also a false flag that may trip up future agents

Go ahead and execute this: "If nothing is done, the merge loop will hit both at the merge. They're cheaper to fix while the two streams are still running. I could write this trial's result into llm-d…

Directional answers to your questions: 1) Sounds good. 2) High confidence and low risk decisions, with risk defined as anything that may be difficult to recover or redo later - I would rather bias to…
Can we safely start the current feature loop in parallel (of course, using a separate workspace) while the current one completes? It is job / build heavy, so completing slowly.
Launch this for me in tmux
